title: List of The Magicians (American TV series) episodes
premise_summary: The Magicians is an American fantasy television series that aired on Syfy and is based on the novel of the same name by Lev Grossman. Michael London, Janice Williams, John McNamara, and Sera Gamble served as executive producers. A 13-episode order was placed for the first season in May 2015, and the series premiered on December 16, 2015, as a special preview.
